bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating disparities in Demographic Parity (DP) and Equalized Odds (EO) using gender as the sensitive attribute on tabular data (predicting income in the Adult dataset) and image data (classifying attributes like attractive, wavy hair, and smiling in the CelebA dataset).

Measuring Demographic Parity (DP) and Equalized Odds (EO) for toxicity classification on the Jigsaw toxic comment dataset, specifically treating race (black and asian identities) as the sensitive attribute.
